name: Screenprint Pull
desc: A proof building on the press bed — the squeegee drags a bead of thick opaque spot ink across the mesh and lays another hard-cut stencil down, flooded ridges and starved bald patches streaking along the pull, pinholes where the ink never got through, the oldest coats sinking into the chipboard as fresh ones go over the top.

energy.doc: press vigour — stencil size, streak contrast, squeegee bead, pull rate, sheen

density.doc: how many coats stay on the sheet (3 to 7) and how busy each stencil is

speed.doc: rate multiplier on the pull clock

hue.doc: anchor hue — rotates the whole ink library and the stock together

x.doc: centre of the image area, x

y.doc: centre of the image area, y

streak.doc: squeegee streaking, starvation and pinhole count — 0 is a clean shop

act.doc: multi-minute program: steady proofing / a fast edition run / coverage swells and collapses over minutes

style.doc: aesthetic: opaque spot inks on chipboard / two transparent inks overprinting to a third on warm stock / raised glossy puff ink with a cast shadow on black / gold and pewter with a raking sheen / figure-ground reversed — the ink is everything the stencil is not, near-monochrome

seed.doc: deterministic shop — ink rotation, stencil archetypes, streaks, stock fibre
